about: The task-history eval set (ADR-0066). Each query names the refs a good answer holds. tools/history/eval.ts scores recall@k and MRR for words only, meaning only and hybrid. Schema: version 1; k (the cut-off); queries[] of { id (unique), lang ("ar" | "en"), query, expected (refs: todo:<n>, order:<uuid>, result:<uuid>, msg:<n>, plan:<n>, note:<n>, att:<n>, dec:<uuid>, mem:<n>, line:<n>), project (optional), kinds (optional) }. These two rows are samples: the verify step (plan task 20) writes the real set from a ledger copy, at least 10 Arabic and 10 English queries.
